editorial: Imagine a week where every burst of college spirit feels like a pulse of electric excitement. Athiradi flips a stifling, officially banned festival into an intense, high-energy battleground where art collides with authority. Samkutty's impromptu rally turns each rehearsal into a literal choreography of defiance, turning the stage into a living battlefield. You, who relish the raw cadence of youthful rebellion, will find this student drama a relentless, adrenaline-charged experience.
targetAudience: Ideal for audiences craving adrenaline-filled campus drama that balances youthful rebellion with societal commentary.
